subject: Mental Models
title: Elasticity
description: A quick, practical guide to Elasticity.

hook.text: Gasoline prices doubled, but people kept driving. Luxury handbag prices doubled, and sales plummeted.

buildup.text: Elasticity measures how sensitive demand is to a price change. Necessities are inelastic; luxuries are elastic.

discovery.text: Insulin is perfectly inelastic. Diabetics will pay almost anything.

twist.text: Time changes elasticity. Gasoline is inelastic short-term because you need your car.

climax.text: Knowing elasticity tells you who has power. If customers have no alternatives, the seller controls the deal.

punchline.text: No alternatives means no bargaining power. That is elasticity.

quiz.question: Why is insulin considered inelastic?
options: Diabetics will pay almost any price because they need it to survive
